name: Nihongo Master v1.0.3
changelog: v1.0.3: Photorealistic Stage 3 (Coastal Beach) tropical surf overhaul matching aerial coastal reference photography. Features radiant tropical emerald-turquoise ocean with crystalline shallow aquamarine, organic reticulated seafoam lace webbing, multi-tiered curved rolling breakers with aerated whitecaps, fine pale ivory beach sand, and smooth continuous swash & backwash dynamics with zero tearing.
